text: The Ultimate Gatekeeper: Why Xi Jinping Built a Cage Around His Chief of Staff | Digging into ChinaThis video script analyzes the strategic precautions Xi Jinping has taken against his high-ranking Chief of Staff, Cai Qi. Drawing direct parallels to the 1976 Huairentang Incident—the Chinese Communist Party's only successful palace coup orchestrated by Mao’s security chief, Wang Dongxing—the narrative explores how Xi has systematically dismantled the exact structural conditions required for such a rebellion.While elevating Cai Qi’s bureaucratic status, Xi has stripped his office of operational control over the elite Central Security Bureau and fragmented Beijing’s military networks. Furthermore, by neutralizing the traditional line of succession and continuously purging high-level military barons, Xi has effectively removed the other two pillars of the classic coup triangle.
